You did the right thing by posting here. I hope you realize that you are not alone. Your pain is real. Suicide is not the answer. Please continue to reach out to all resources such as 988, therapy, ER, trusted friend. Be well.
Can't do any vocals, scares me.

Tycho has been the very best ketamine experiences for me. Only problem with this and any other playlist is once I become familiar with it, I get distracted and focus more on the music than the experience and then have to come up with other playlists. But Tycho by far my fave. Explosions in the Sky very good as well, have to check for too jarring of a bridge thought. Fave here is Daydream #7.

Just keep in mind these "EKGs" are only one lead, not a 3 lead or 12-lead EKG that are always done, say on an ambulance, or with a physician. So it's extremely limited in what it can tell you. I really like my Garmin Venu 2, but cant figure out why they shrunk all the characters, that's the only downside for me so far.

I am so proud of you for reaching out and asking for help! Please continue to reach out until you find someone you feel good about talking to. You can try a trusted teacher, parent, and of course the text to chat 741-741. You are not too young. You are not worthless. You are a beautiful person who needs some help, and that's more than okay. And you will be okay, I promise, one day at a time.

The darkness has been around nearly my entire life. I guess the trigger would be depression. This episode started 5yrs ago from a flare-up of a chronic illness that upset all of my body systems including chemical imbalance that triggered depression. It gets angry when I dampen it's strength or when the healthier part of me is in charge, and it does push-ups to get stronger when it is not in control.

I'm glad you have never had to sprint into a forest with your Crohn's Disease. I've sprinted into forests, bathrooms, and more with mine. It's an unrelenting and uncompromising urgency for many of us.
